marvel.summary: Marvel's stories began in comics and extend into film, television, animation, and games. Characters including Spider-Man, the Avengers, and the X-Men share a fictional universe, with different adaptations offering their own versions of its heroes and their adventures.

star-wars.summary: Created by George Lucas, Star Wars began with the 1977 film later titled A New Hope. Its space-fantasy stories follow the Jedi, the Sith, and conflicts across a distant galaxy, told through films, television, animation, books, comics, and games.

dc.summary: DC publishes the comic-book stories of Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, and the Justice League. Its characters also appear in films, television series, animation, and games, with stories ranging from individual heroes' lives to adventures that bring them together.

vince-gilligan.summary: Vince Gilligan is a writer, producer, and director who created Breaking Bad and co-created Better Call Saul. His television work also includes writing and producing The X-Files, while El Camino continues Jesse Pinkman's story from Breaking Bad in a feature film.

justin-roiland.summary: Justin Roiland is a voice actor, writer, and producer who co-created Rick and Morty and Solar Opposites. He provided voices for both series during their early seasons, and his other animation work includes characters in Adventure Time and Gravity Falls.

chiwetel-ejiofor.summary: Chiwetel Ejiofor works as an actor, writer, and director across film, television, and theatre. His performances include Solomon Northup in 12 Years a Slave and the Operative in Serenity. He also wrote and directed The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind.
knownFor: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind

kane-parsons.summary: Kane Parsons makes films under the name Kane Pixels, combining writing, directing, and visual effects. He created the online horror series The Backrooms and The Oldest View, using computer-generated environments and found-footage storytelling to build their fictional worlds.

donald-glover.summary: Donald Glover is an actor, writer, and musician who performs music as Childish Gambino. His television work includes Community, and he created and starred in Atlanta. His films include playing Lando Calrissian in Solo: A Star Wars Story.

michael-pena.summary: Michael Peña is an actor and producer whose film work includes Crash, End of Watch, American Hustle, and Ant-Man. Raised in Chicago, he began working in film and television after winning a role through an open casting call for To Sir, with Love II.

jake-gyllenhaal.summary: Jake Gyllenhaal is an actor and producer with roles in Donnie Darko, Brokeback Mountain, Nightcrawler, and Prisoners. He made his film debut in City Slickers as a child and has also performed on stage, including in London's West End.

kyle-chandler.summary: Kyle Chandler is an actor whose television work includes Friday Night Lights and Bloodline. His film credits include Argo, Super 8, Manchester by the Sea, and The Wolf of Wall Street, alongside work as a producer and director.

leonardo-dicaprio.summary: Leonardo DiCaprio is an actor and producer whose films include Titanic, The Aviator, The Departed, and The Wolf of Wall Street. He began working in television and films as a child before taking leading roles in collaborations with directors including Martin Scorsese and Christopher Nolan.

matt-damon.summary: Matt Damon is an actor, writer, and producer who co-wrote and starred in Good Will Hunting. His screen work also includes The Martian, The Talented Mr. Ripley, and The Departed, with roles across drama, science fiction, and crime films.

michael-mando.summary: Michael Mando is an actor whose performances include Nacho Varga in Better Call Saul and Vaas Montenegro in the video game Far Cry 3. His work spans television, film, and performance capture, with further television appearances in Orphan Black.

brad-pitt.summary: Brad Pitt is an actor and producer whose film credits include Fight Club, 12 Monkeys, Moneyball, and Mr. & Mrs. Smith. He began with television roles before his appearance in Thelma & Louise brought wider attention to his work on screen.

george-lucas.summary: George Lucas is a writer, director, and producer who created Star Wars and founded Lucasfilm. He wrote and directed THX 1138 and American Graffiti before Star Wars, and his producing and story work also helped establish the Indiana Jones films.

george-clooney.summary: George Clooney is an actor, director, and producer who played Dr. Doug Ross in ER. His film performances include Michael Clayton and Up in the Air, while his work behind the camera includes directing Good Night, and Good Luck.

diego-luna.summary: Diego Luna works as an actor, director, and producer, with film credits including Y tu mamá también and The Book of Life. He portrayed rebel operative Cassian Andor in Rogue One: A Star Wars Story and the television series Andor.
knownFor: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

grant-gustin.summary: Grant Gustin is an actor and singer who played Barry Allen in The Flash and Sebastian Smythe in Glee. His background includes musical-theatre training and performing in a touring production of West Side Story before his work on television.

ryan-gosling.summary: Ryan Gosling is an actor, producer, and director whose film performances include The Notebook, Drive, Blue Valentine, and La La Land. He began performing as a child on The Mickey Mouse Club before moving into television series and feature films.

benedict-cumberbatch.summary: Benedict Cumberbatch is an actor and producer whose work spans theatre, television, film, and radio. His screen roles include Sherlock Holmes in Sherlock and Stephen Strange in Doctor Strange, alongside performances in The Imitation Game and Star Trek Into Darkness.

robert-pattinson.summary: Robert Pattinson is an actor and producer whose films include Twilight and The Batman. He began performing with an amateur theatre group in London before moving into screen roles, with work in both large studio productions and independent films.

steven-ogg.summary: Steven Ogg is an actor whose work includes voice and performance capture for Trevor Philips in Grand Theft Auto V. His screen credits include The Walking Dead and He Never Died, alongside appearances in television series such as Law & Order.

ned-luke.summary: Ned Luke is an actor and director with credits in Grand Theft Auto V, Boardwalk Empire, and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. His work combines video-game performance with television appearances, including roles in the original Law & Order series.

michael-cera.summary: Michael Cera is an actor and musician who played George Michael Bluth in Arrested Development. His film roles include Superbad, Juno, and Scott Pilgrim vs. the World. Alongside acting, he sings and plays guitar and bass.

tom-hiddleston.summary: Tom Hiddleston is an actor and producer who first portrayed Loki in Thor and returned to the role in The Avengers. Trained at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, he has also worked in theatre and films including High-Rise.

nicolas-cage.summary: Nicolas Cage is an actor, producer, and director with film roles in Leaving Las Vegas, The Rock, and Face/Off. Born Nicolas Coppola, he adopted his professional surname early in his career and began taking leading roles with Valley Girl.

oscar-isaac.summary: Oscar Isaac is an actor and producer who trained at the Juilliard School after growing up in Miami. His film performances include Inside Llewyn Davis, A Most Violent Year, and Ex Machina, alongside work in the Star Wars films.

steven-yeun.summary: Steven Yeun is an actor and producer whose films include Minari, Okja, and Nope. He studied at Kalamazoo College before pursuing acting and worked with comedy groups in Chicago, including Stir Friday Night and the Second City.

andrew-santino.summary: Andrew Santino is a comedian, actor, and podcast host whose film work includes Ricky Stanicky and The Disaster Artist. He hosts the interview podcast Whiskey Ginger and co-hosts Bad Friends with Bobby Lee, alongside his stand-up comedy work.

bobby-lee.summary: Bobby Lee is an actor, writer, and comedian whose television work includes Mad TV. His film credits include Paul and A Very Harold & Kumar Christmas. He also co-hosts the comedy podcast Bad Friends with Andrew Santino.

john-cena.summary: John Cena is an actor and professional wrestler whose wrestling career began before his work in feature films. His screen credits include The Suicide Squad, F9: The Fast Saga, and Ricky Stanicky, alongside work as a producer and writer.

christopher-nolan.summary: Christopher Nolan is a writer, director, and producer whose films include Memento, The Prestige, Interstellar, and Dunkirk. He began making short films as a child and made his first feature, Following, before moving into larger independent and studio productions.

joel-mchale.summary: Joel McHale is an actor, writer, and producer whose television work includes Community and The Soup. He trained in acting at the University of Washington and appeared in Seattle's Almost Live! before moving into film and national television work.

bob-odenkirk.summary: Bob Odenkirk is an actor, writer, and producer whose work includes Better Call Saul and Mr. Show with Bob and David. His background includes comedy writing for Saturday Night Live and The Ben Stiller Show, alongside film performances such as Nobody.
knownFor: Mr. Show with Bob and David

aaron-paul.summary: Aaron Paul is an actor and producer who portrayed Jesse Pinkman in Breaking Bad and El Camino. His other film work includes Need for Speed and The Last House on the Left, following early appearances in television series and films.
knownFor: The Last House on the Left

bryan-cranston.summary: Bryan Cranston is an actor, producer, and writer whose television roles include Walter White in Breaking Bad and Hal in Malcolm in the Middle. His film work includes Argo and Trumbo, and he portrayed Lyndon B. Johnson on stage in All the Way.

gabriel-macht.summary: Gabriel Macht is an actor, producer, and director whose screen work includes Suits, The Good Shepherd, and The Spirit. He began acting as a child, studied at Carnegie Mellon's School of Drama, and has performed in theatre as well as on screen.
knownFor: A Love Song for Bobby Long

josh-hutcherson.summary: Josh Hutcherson is an actor, producer, and director whose films include The Hunger Games and Zathura: A Space Adventure. He began working in television as a child before appearing in feature films, including American Splendor and Little Manhattan.

rick-hoffman.summary: Rick Hoffman is an actor who portrayed Louis Litt in the legal drama Suits. His television credits also include Billions, while his film work includes Hostel and Thanksgiving, spanning legal drama and horror across his screen career.

patrick-j-adams.summary: Patrick J. Adams is an actor, producer, and director who portrayed Mike Ross in Suits and astronaut John Glenn in The Right Stuff. His work also includes the film Clara and theatre productions such as The Last Match.

anya-taylor-joy.summary: Anya Taylor-Joy is an actress and producer whose roles include Beth Harmon in The Queen's Gambit and Thomasin in The Witch. Her film work also includes Split and Thoroughbreds, following a childhood spent in Argentina and England.

sadie-sink.summary: Sadie Sink is an actress whose screen roles include Max in Stranger Things and Ziggy Berman in the Fear Street films. She began in theatre, performing in Annie and The Audience on Broadway, before further work in film and television.
knownFor: All Too Well: The Short Film

giancarlo-esposito.summary: Giancarlo Esposito is an actor whose screen work includes Breaking Bad, Do the Right Thing, and The Usual Suspects. He began performing on Broadway as a child before moving into film and television, including Homicide: Life on the Street.

jonathan-banks.summary: Jonathan Banks is an actor who portrayed Mike Ehrmantraut in Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul. His film credits include Gremlins, Mudbound, and The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension, alongside work on stage and television.

jesse-plemons.summary: Jesse Plemons is an actor whose television roles include Landry Clarke in Friday Night Lights and Todd Alquist in Breaking Bad. His film performances include Game Night, The Irishman, I'm Thinking of Ending Things, and The Power of the Dog.

ethan-hawke.summary: Ethan Hawke is an actor, writer, and producer whose films include Training Day and Richard Linklater's Before trilogy. He began acting in Explorers and Dead Poets Society, and has also worked in theatre and written novels, including The Hottest State.

mark-hamill.summary: Mark Hamill is an actor and voice actor who portrayed Luke Skywalker in the original Star Wars trilogy and its sequels. His voice work includes the Joker in Batman: The Animated Series, alongside film appearances in The Big Red One and Corvette Summer.

samuel-l-jackson.summary: Samuel L. Jackson is an actor and producer whose roles include Jules Winnfield in Pulp Fiction and Nick Fury in Marvel films. His work also includes the Star Wars prequels and voicing Frozone in The Incredibles.

taron-egerton.summary: Taron Egerton is an actor and singer who portrayed Eggsy in the Kingsman films and Elton John in Rocketman. His other performances include Eddie the Eagle and voicing Johnny in Sing, following training at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art.

matthew-judge.summary: Matthew Judge creates online videos under the name DarkViperAU, with work centred on Grand Theft Auto V. His credited projects include DarkViperAU, the challenge series Pacifist %, and The Viper Rambles Podcast, combining gaming videos with spoken commentary.

kevan-brighting.summary: Kevan Brighting is a voice actor and narrator whose game work includes The Stanley Parable and its expanded edition, Ultra Deluxe. He provides the narration that accompanies the player's choices, and his other game credits include Void Bastards.

james-mcavoy.summary: James McAvoy is an actor whose films include Atonement, The Last King of Scotland, Filth, and Split. His screen roles also include Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men films, alongside theatre performances in Macbeth and The Ruling Class.

dan-harmon.summary: Dan Harmon is a writer, producer, and director who created Community and co-created Rick and Morty. His comedy work also includes writing and producing the earlier series Computerman and Laser Fart, across live-action and animated television.

keanu-reeves.summary: Keanu Reeves is an actor and producer whose films include The Matrix, Speed, Point Break, and the John Wick series. His earlier work includes River's Edge and Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure, with roles spanning drama, comedy, science fiction, and action.

alan-morrison.summary: Alan Morrison is an actor, writer, and producer who co-founded the comedy group Viva La Dirt League. His screen credits include Epic NPC Man, PUBG Logic, Bored, and Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure, combining online sketches with narrative films.
knownFor: Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure

adam-king.summary: Adam King is an actor, director, and producer who co-founded Viva La Dirt League. His work with the group includes Epic NPC Man, Bored, Witcher Logic, and Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure, bringing together gaming parody and character comedy.
knownFor: Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure

references.label: Auckland Council: Viva La Dirt League

ben-van-lier.summary: Ben Van Lier is an actor and writer whose work includes Viva La Dirt League's Epic NPC Man and Techtown. His other screen credits include The Water Horse and American Playboy: The Hugh Hefner Story, alongside writing and performing in theatre.
knownFor: American Playboy: The Hugh Hefner Story

britt-scott-clark.summary: Britt Scott Clark is an actress, writer, and director who played Mia Halston in Doctor Doctor. Her screen credits include Shortland Street, My Life Is Murder, and Ablaze, alongside writing and performing with the comedy group Viva La Dirt League.

byron-coll.summary: Byron Coll works as an actor and composer, with screen credits including The Luminaries, Top of the Lake, and Shadow in the Cloud. His film work also includes Daffodils, alongside his work in television and music.

hamish-parkinson.summary: Hamish Parkinson is an actor, writer, and director whose work includes screen comedy and live performance. His credits include Thor: Ragnarok, Hunt for the Wilderpeople, and Viva La Dirt League, and he co-created the comedy project Fuq Boiz with Ryan Richards.

rowan-bettjeman.summary: Rowan Bettjeman is an actor, producer, and director who co-founded Viva La Dirt League. His work includes Bored, D&D Logic, and Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure, with comedy built around gaming and the situations of everyday life.
knownFor: Baelin's Route: An Epic NPC Man Adventure

rowan-atkinson.summary: Rowan Atkinson is an actor, writer, and producer whose television work includes Mr. Bean, Blackadder, and Not the Nine O'Clock News. His film roles include Johnny English and Four Weddings and a Funeral, following early work in comedy revues.

cooper-tomlinson.summary: Cooper Tomlinson is an actor, writer, and producer who co-created the sketch-comedy channel That's a Bad Idea with Curry Barker. Their collaborations include the web series Roommates and the found-footage film Milk & Serial, which Tomlinson produced and starred in.

curry-barker.summary: Curry Barker writes, directs, and performs in films and online comedy. He co-created That's a Bad Idea with Cooper Tomlinson, and his directing work includes the horror short The Chair and the found-footage feature Milk & Serial.

jeremy-allen-white.summary: Jeremy Allen White is an actor whose television roles include Lip Gallagher in Shameless and Carmy Berzatto in The Bear. His film work includes The Iron Claw, The Rental, and Afterschool, alongside television appearances in Homecoming.

sam-houser.summary: Sam Houser is a video-game producer and co-founder of Rockstar Games. His credits include Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, Oni, and Max Payne, with work across game production, creative development, and the management of projects at the studio.

mark-fischbach.summary: Mark Fischbach creates videos as Markiplier, with work that includes game commentary, sketch comedy, and interactive stories. His projects include A Date with Markiplier, A Heist with Markiplier, and In Space with Markiplier, which let viewers choose different story paths.

sean-mcloughlin.summary: Seán McLoughlin creates online videos under the name Jacksepticeye. His work includes gameplay and commentary series such as Inside Playthrough and Papers, Please Playthrough, alongside screen appearances including Free Guy and writing and directing credits for his online projects.

isack-hadjar.summary: Isack Hadjar is a racing driver who progressed through karting and junior single-seater championships before his Formula 1 debut in 2025. His earlier career included Formula 3 race wins and a runner-up finish in the 2024 Formula 2 championship.

felix-kjellberg.summary: Felix Kjellberg is a video creator who publishes as PewDiePie, beginning with video-game commentary and playthroughs. His credited projects include PewDiePie, Scare PewDiePie, Pew News, and Minecraft Epic, bringing together gaming videos, commentary, and online entertainment.

max-verstappen.summary: Max Verstappen is a racing driver and Formula 1 world champion whose career began in karting. He won his first Grand Prix in Spain in 2016 and his first Formula 1 drivers' championship in 2021, racing under a Dutch licence.
